<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Creates a test fixture for a TimestampSigner instance with a fixed secret key for testing purposes.

Description: This class is used to create a test fixture for a TimestampSigner instance with a fixed secret key. It is instantiated by the testing framework and used to generate signed values for testing the behavior of the TimestampSigner class.

Attributes:
    signer_factory (Callable): Returns a partial instance of TimestampSigner with a fixed secret key for testing.

Methods:
    test_max_age (Callable): Tests the behavior when the signature age exceeds the allowed maximum age.
    test_return_timestamp (Callable): Tests the behavior of returning the timestamp along with the unsigned value.
    test_timestamp_missing (Callable): Tests the behavior when the date_signed field is missing.
    test_malformed_timestamp (Callable): Tests the behavior when the timestamp is malformed.
    test_malformed_future_timestamp (Callable): Tests the behavior when the timestamp is malformed and from the future.
    test_future_age (Callable): Tests the behavior when the signature age is in the future.
    test_sig_error_date_signed (Callable): Tests the behavior when the date_signed field is invalid after modification.
</DOCSTRING>
